scope: Theorem 7.4 (Input insertion in a periodic compact force) of the manuscript “Prefix Instructions and Incompressible Flows” (preprints/Prefix-Instructions-and-Incompressible-Flows-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8cd581420ec9967a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: This processor gives an effective smooth general force on R3 with period one from zero, a fixed compact spatial support, and all mixed derivatives bounded. Its zero-data solution is globally smooth, has uniformly bounded energy, and is unique among smooth classical solutions with u ∈ CtH2 ∩ C1 t L2, p ∈ CtH1, and bounded velocity and gradient on each finite time interval. The particle from the origin has first coordinate greater than 2 at some time exactly when the machine halts. The formula is effective relative to any fixed real ν > 0.
